verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an online filing portal, which could plausibly offer something like automatic recurring annual-report filing, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only manual filing through the Annual Report Wizard and an electronic annual-report reminder. A reminder is an adjacent notification feature, not a user-schedulable recurring job or workflow. Probes also found no public API, OpenAPI spec or llms.txt that could support programmatic scheduling.
